difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 6.12.4 at source lines 1870-1877: a dependent recursion principle for the total space Sigma w:W P(w), where P is defined recursively along the path constructor of W. The proof (source lines 1878-1920) is one of the technical core steps of the flattening lemma and is not a citation: the definition is produced by induction on W at lines 1879-1882, and the coherence obligation is then reworked through three separate manoeuvres, thm:dpath-forall at line 1885, the transport computation with the path q from thm:transport-is-given at line 1887, and thm:transport-compose at line 1894, before the two transports can be combined into p-tilde'(b,y) at lines 1901-1919 and the hypothesis p(b,y) can be applied. The statement records none of these steps and the lemma is stated for an arbitrary family Q over the total space.
